summary: PNC Financial Services Group filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (Rule 424(b)(5), Form 424B5) for an offering of senior unsecured notes in two tranches: fixed-rate notes that convert to floating (Compounded SOFR plus a spread) beginning October 2028, and floating-rate notes indexed to Compounded SOFR, both maturing October 2029. Principal amounts, coupons, and spreads are left blank pending pricing. PNC Capital Markets LLC, Citigroup, and Morgan Stanley are joint book-running managers; PNC's affiliate participation triggers FINRA Rule 5121 conflicts procedures. This is a routine debt capital-raising shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch final pricing and spread.
